comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Asset-light two-sided online marketplace earning take-rate fees from consumers and independent providers; closest business model, though home services rather than travel.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Owns upscale hotel real estate as a REIT; capital-intensive asset owner, unlike Airbnb's asset-light commission marketplace.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: B2B travel distribution and airline IT software sold to suppliers and agencies, not a consumer lodging marketplace.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Lodging REIT owning select-service hotels; earns room revenue from owned assets rather than marketplace commissions.
